name: Female Bedspace near MOA (Bautista St, Pasay)
address: Bautista Street, Barangay 138, Pasay City, near Metropoint and LRT/MRT stations
description: A women-only bedspace in a Pasay apartment that takes groups of three to four, with at most one male in a group. Beds come with mattresses, lockers and fans, and residents share the kitchen, dining, living and laundry areas. The neighborhood is monitored by barangay CCTV, and Mall of Asia, Baclaran and Makati are each a single ride away.
houseRules: Minimum 6-month stay. 1 month advance and 2 months deposit. Valid ID or NBI clearance required. Electricity, water, WiFi and gas are shared among tenants.

name: Private Room with Shared Bathroom, Gotamco St
description: Rooms on the third floor of a family house in Pasay, each with access to a shared bathroom. It is a basic, low-cost set-up suited to students or workers who want a private space. Note that the rooms are reached by stairs.

name: Aguara St Bedspace near Baclaran Church
address: Aguara Street, Baclaran, Pasay City, near Baclaran Church
description: Air-conditioned bedspace in a room shared by eight people, a short walk from Baclaran Church and the LRT-1 Baclaran area. Pillows and bedsheets are provided, so a new tenant can move in with just a bag. Photos show steel bunk beds, a wall fan and a small kitchen sink.

name: Sun Valley Female Bedspace, Parañaque
address: 4030 St. Culdesac, Sun Valley, Parañaque City
description: A bedspace for women in Sun Valley, with bunk beds in simple furnished rooms. Water and electricity are already part of the monthly rent. The area is close to SM Bicutan and the Sucat corridor.

name: Bedspace in BF Homes Parañaque
address: Bb. Ramona Tirona St., B.F. Homes, Parañaque City, near St. Luke's Hospital
description: A bedspace in a spacious BF Homes house with large rooms holding bunk beds, stand fans and a window aircon unit. Tenants share a roomy tiled bathroom. It sits in a quiet subdivision near St. Luke's Hospital.

name: BF Resort Village Bedspace, Las Piñas
address: B5 Lot 52 JB Tan Street, BF Resort Village, Talon Dos, Las Piñas City
description: An air-conditioned bedspace with WiFi inside the gated BF Resort Village. Rooms are compact with built-in bunk-style beds and wood-panelled finishes. The village is a short ride from SM Southmall and Alabang.

name: Female Bedspace, Narra St, Golden Acres
address: Narra St., Golden Acres Subdivision, Talon 5, Las Piñas City, near Marcos Alvarez Ave.
description: A women-only bedspace in a Las Piñas subdivision, with one shared bathroom for six residents and an induction cooker for simple meals. Electricity, Maynilad water and WiFi are covered by the rent. SM Southmall, Puregold and Jollibee Molino are one ride away.
houseRules: No pets. No four-wheel parking. 1 month advance and 1 month deposit. Police/NBI and barangay clearance, valid ID and vaccine card required.

name: Dorm Suites Alabang
address: T. Molina St., Molina Rotonda, Alabang, Muntinlupa City
description: A rental near the Alabang rotonda aimed at people working or studying around Alabang. The room is fully furnished with its own bathroom. Utilities are billed separately from the monthly rate.
houseRules: Post-dated checks required. Water, electricity and internet billed separately.

name: Segundina Townhomes Ladies Bedspace, Putatan
address: Segundina Townhomes, Putatan, Muntinlupa City, near Muntinlupa City Hall and Medical Center
description: Ladies' bedspaces in a gated townhouse with round-the-clock security and access to a mini clubhouse and pool. Rooms have two double-deck beds with foam, a fan, vanity mirror and cabinet. A dining set, electric stove, two bathrooms and a covered laundry area are shared. Basic electricity and water are included.

name: Lady Bedspace, M.L. Quezon St, Cupang
address: M.L. Quezon Street, Cupang, Muntinlupa City, near Filinvest and Starmall Alabang
description: An affordable lady bedspace in Cupang, within reach of Filinvest, Starmall Alabang, Amkor and FEU Alabang. Rooms are in a small compound with a parking area. Good for nearby office and school-going women.
